verdict.rationale: Formant is a cloud SaaS platform for robot fleets, so choosing a data-storage region is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence documents selecting a storage region or residency. The nearest items are adjacent controls: choosing which data streams upload to the cloud, and setting custom local agent directories. Neither lets a user choose where cloud data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
